1.mascotDialogue: She is insertion sort, tesoro, given permission to take big steps first! Shrink the gap enough times, and she collapses into ordinary insertion sort for the final, finest pass.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2's gap starts at n over 2 and halves every outer pass. Lines 6 to 8 are simply insertion sort's inner loop, comparing arr[j] to arr[j minus gap] instead of arr[j minus 1].

3.mascotDialogue: Watch these first comparisons skip across three positions at once — this is a gap of 3, making long-distance corrections before the finer gap-of-1 pass even begins!

4.mascotDialogue: A subtle kind of bug, this one — the output, she is correct, but the algorithm has quietly stopped being the algorithm she claims to be. Not every bug crashes — some simply throw away the whole reason you chose her.
